# S2.1 — Helper + container: the out-of-process `hh-helper` binary over `hh-helper/1`, commit-proof admission + verbatim token echo, helper-enforced deadlines, `local_sandboxed`/`local_container` backends, heal/replace, `fs_tree`, `derive`, executor-side dedup + `preserve_until` (R-2.5.5 · R-2.2.5 · R-2.5.5¹)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5d.5 / §5a.5 (`R-2.5.5`, `R-2.2.5`,
`R-2.5.5¹` C1 slice)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/032_S2.1__helper-and-container.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.5.5 · R-2.2.5 · R-2.5.5¹**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.27` (stacked) · **Stage:** 2 ·
**Live stage:** podman-authorized (gate decision `34fd5d9` — podman
6.1.0, darwin/arm64)

## Summary

Execution is **out of the kernel process**. The kernel stays
authoritative — authorization, ledger mutation, lifecycle, observation —
while the `hh-helper` binary executes and reports frames it cannot
forged-sign and cannot authorize.

### `crates/hh-helper` (new crate + `hh-helper` binary)
- `hh-helper/1` — closed verb sum (`hello`/`resume_session_id`/`exec`/
  `read`/`probe`/`cancel`/`terminate`/`env_apply`/`fs.*`/`snapshot`/
  `diff`), NDJSON over an AF_UNIX session socket through the shared
  `hh-wire` codec; strict parse ⇒ typed `protocol_error` on malformed
  frames.
- **Admission:** `commit_proof = idp_id("commit_token", nonce ∥
  effect_id ∥ attempt_no)` minted by the kernel, recomputed by the
  helper — absent/forged/misbound ⇒ `NotCommitted`. The
  `attribution_token` is echoed verbatim in every journal frame;
  wrong/absent echo drops the item + `action.effect.unattributed`.
- **Deadlines are helper-local:** TERM→KILL ladder on the process
  group, classification recorded before terminal notify so `read`
  observes `deadline_exceeded`. Detached groups are recorded on
  `detached[]` at reap (no blocking on inherited pipes) and surfaced
  via `list_detached`/`terminate_detached`.
- **Backends:** `direct`, `local_sandboxed` (macOS Seatbelt —
  generated deny-default SBPL profile), `local_container` (podman —
  `docker://` images, `--network none --read-only --cap-drop ALL`,
  workspace bind mount, `podman stats` meters, `Unavailable` when the
  runtime is absent).
- **`fs_tree`:** content-addressed `tree/1` manifests — snapshot /
  verify / restore / diff; equal state ⇒ equal `snapshot_ref`.
- **C1 halves under `tier-c1`** (default feature): windowed
  `DedupStore` binding terminal verdicts to `idempotency_key`
  (replay ⇒ recorded verdict, never re-run) + `preserve_until` on
  kernel loss. `--no-default-features` ⇒ typed `unsupported` refusals
  — honest removability, never silent degradation.

### `crates/hh-env` (kernel side)
- `HelperClient` + `HelperExecutor` (`ToolExecutor` over the wire) +
  `HelperBackend` (`ContainmentBackend` over the live wire — live
  `probed`/`applied` evidence replaces `Ep2Model`).
- Environment lifecycle: `mark_unreachable` / `reattach` / `replace` /
  `heal` with `on_loss ∈ {fail_run, replace_from_snapshot,
  replace_from_image}` and `action.world_state.discontinuity`.
- `derive(fresh_from_image | fork_snapshot | scoped_subtree)` with
  `effective = meet(parent, layer)` containment; `share` refused
  `unsupported` (C1+).
- `fs_change` via kernel baselines: the helper scans, the kernel diffs
  — observation stays a kernel authority.
- Per-class meters: provision/snapshot/resume ms, disk/snapshot bytes,
  container cpu/mem; `Unavailable` provenance where unmeasured.
- Session sockets under `temp_dir()` with content-derived short names
  (darwin's 104-byte AF_UNIX limit); `{session_id, nonce, sock_path}`
  persist for `resume`.

## Deferrals

- **Closed DF-S1.12-3** — the live out-of-process EP2 helper replacing

- Opened: none.

## Deviations / ADRs

- **ADR-0263** — socket rendezvous under `temp_dir()` (darwin AF_UNIX
  limit) + persisted `sock_path`; kernel-side `fs_change` diffing;
  podman `docker://` spelling and meter source; `tier-c1` feature
  gating; NDJSON-over-AF_UNIX substrate choice.
